subject: pass list of matrices to TMB

messages.author: d53f3b9a3d56d6e5
messages.subject: pass list of matrices to TMB
parts:
Hi,

My data consists of a list of matrices with integer values.

Any one of these on their own I would pass to TMB using DATA_IMATRIX()

How can I send the whole list so that in the end TMB stores them as vector<matrix<int> >

Looking at DATA_STRUCT() example I don't want to have to name each one as there could be ~100 of them, not sure how I can do this.

The other way I thought to do it was to send a 3D array and slice it up in C++ but there doesn't seem to be an easy way to do that either.

Andy

messages.author: 258b98968d0ad8b9
messages.subject: Re: pass list of matrices to TMB
parts:
Inspired by
https://github.com/kaskr/adcomp/issues/96
and
https://github.com/kaskr/adcomp/blob/abbd69a1a684b4b8e442a4c73fbc41f3ba921540/TMB/inst/include/tmb_core.hpp#L372
you could modify to something like (not tested):


#include<TMB.hpp>

/* List of integer matrices */
template<class Type>
struct LOIM_t : vector<matrix<int> > {
  LOIM_t(SEXP x){  /* x = List passed from R */
    (*this).resize(LENGTH(x));
    for(int i=0; i<LENGTH(x); i++){
      SEXP sm = VECTOR_ELT(x, i);
      if(!Rf_isMatrix(sm)) Rf_error("Not a matrix");
      (*this)(i) = asMatrix<int>(sm);
    }
  }
};

template<class Type>
Type objective_function<Type>::operator() ()
{
  // x = list of sparse matrices
  DATA_STRUCT(x, LOIM_t);
  // Get the first...
  matrix<int> y = x(0);
  REPORT(y);
  return 0;

}

parts: There's an asArray in tmbutils namespace. Try the following:

#include <TMB.hpp>

/* List of integer matrices */
template<class Type>

struct LOA_t : vector<array<Type> > {
  LOA_t(SEXP x){  /* x = List passed from R */

(*this).resize(LENGTH(x));
    for(int i=0; i<LENGTH(x); i++){
      SEXP sm = VECTOR_ELT(x, i);

// x = list of arrays
  DATA_STRUCT(x, LOA_t);
  // Get the first...
  array<Type> y = x(0);
  REPORT(y);
  return 0;
}
